text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, Maruzen-san...! G-good...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Hiiya, Chiyo-chan♪
What brings you all the way over to my classroom?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Actually, we were all talking about playing some basketball together right now...
and we were wondering if you'd like to join, Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san is here too, and so many others gathered...!
W-What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to! You came all the way to invite me? Totally, no doubt about it~! Count me in.
Let me get changed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
! Really!?
Yaay... Well then, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That got way more heated than I expected, desu_ne.
Truly, as they say, "roll a toy around and it ripens into gold"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
A toy... ripens? What a profound saying... but at any rate, yes.
Everyone seems so lively... and full of joy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
And of course, me as well. It has been quite a while since I've worked up a sweat outside of training.
What a truly pleasant time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If you'd like, how about one more match!
Maruzen-san, too—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's it, that's it! Keep your arm tucked in a bit more.
Don't tense up, just keep it straight...
Yep, looking good!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... it went in! Yay!
I'm so glad I asked you, Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san, me next! Teach me too!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text: Me too, me too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ Don't rush, one at a time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, it has turned into a basketball clinic...
Fufu. Everyone simply can't resist wanting to learn from Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Great work out there, Chiyo-chan.
Thanks for inviting me today♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Maruzen-san...!
Did you... um...
Was it okay today?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where'd that come from all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I mean, er... did you... d-did you have fun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Spending time together with everyone got my hype levels through the roof♪
Make sure to invite me again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Is something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...How should I put it, it's just tugging at my heart.
Was Maruzen-san truly... um.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Truly enjoying herself, you mean?
...Fufu. She was enjoying herself, I assure you.
It is simply her nature to put others before herself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...She's so kind.
But... to me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...it feels lonely.
It feels as though Maruzen-san is standing somewhere apart from everyone else...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...I understand. However, that is just how she is...
Hmm... For instance, let's see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: What if there were a game she could enjoy without any hesitation? A game whose sole purpose is simply to have fun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A game just for fun... T-True, if such a game existed, she could play without worrying about others, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san always worries about those who lose, too. What kind of game has no winners or losers...?
choice_data_list: A game without winners or losers?

text_block_list.text:
On my way to the trainer's room, I overhear their conversation.
Catching myself reacting out loud—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, <chrname>!
That's it! A game with no winners or losers!
Do you happen to know of any?
Without fully understanding what they were discussing, I give a vague response.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see... I feel like this could work!
Nothing comes to mind immediately, but I feel like you've given me a crucial hint!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Seek unseen, and the tangled thread unravels"!
I'll think of a game where Maruzen-san can let loose and have a blast with all her heart!
...I didn't know all the details, but seeing Sakura Chiyono O fired up like that made me want to cheer her on.
